identity.name: Nima Moradirad
identity.availability: Based in Iran. Open to relocation and international frontend opportunities.
identity.intro: I build React and Next.js applications, with experience in financial platforms, real-time interfaces, PWAs, and Android delivery.
identity.statement: I build scalable web and mobile products where performance, reliability, and clear design work together.

paragraphs: I’m a frontend engineer with experience in financial platforms, real-time applications, and web-to-Android delivery. I enjoy making complex product flows easier to use and helping teams maintain the systems behind them.

principles.title: Clear boundaries scale
principles.text: Focused domains and shared contracts keep products adaptable.

principles.title: Performance earns trust
principles.text: Fast rendering, caching, and releases make products feel reliable.

principles.title: Rigor enables creativity
principles.text: Accessible, validated delivery turns expressive UI into a useful product.

experience.summary: Shaping frontend architecture and delivery for a B2B financial platform spanning Admin, Employer, Employee, and Support experiences.
highlights: Develop frontend architecture and interfaces across Admin, Employer, Employee, and Support applications.
Maintain PWA update behavior, cache versioning, and offline fallbacks.
Deliver Android applications through Capacitor, including platform integrations and custom Java plugins.
Mentor engineers and contribute to real-time features, validation, and frontend security improvements.

experience.summary: Developed financial-product interfaces with Next.js and TypeScript in collaboration with the product team.
highlights: Built authentication and product interfaces with shared application state.
Contributed to code review and frontend performance work.

experience.summary: Built internal dashboards, integrated REST APIs, and developed reusable frontend interfaces.
highlights: Implemented dashboard workflows with TypeScript and reusable UI components.
Integrated REST APIs and Redux-based application state.

experience.summary: Delivered e-commerce and content experiences with React, JavaScript, component libraries, and modern state management.
highlights: Built React interfaces for e-commerce and content experiences.
Maintained shared components, form validation, and application state.
